verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a Dashboard REST API, but the evidence only shows it returning the data behind dashboard graphs as JSON, which is read-only access to chart results. The Wizard CLI produces a first dashboard as a one-time onboarding step, and the 'Create a dashboard' docs item does not indicate API-based creation. Missing for 10: API endpoints to create, update or delete dashboards; programmatic management of saved charts/insights; documentation of write operations on dashboard objects; independent or hands-on corroboration.
